description: This file defines UI component classes for user management menus in the Mattermost system console, including column toggle, filter popover, role/status filter menus, and date range menu, utilizing Playwright for testing interactions.

classes.name: ColumnToggleMenu
classes.description: Represents a toggle menu for columns, allowing visibility checks, item retrieval, toggling, and closing.

classes.name: FilterPopover
classes.description: Represents a filter popover for user filtering by team, role, and status, with methods to interact with filter options and close the popover.

classes.name: FilterMenu
classes.description: A generic dropdown filter menu for role or status selection, with methods to interact with menu items and close the menu.

classes.name: DateRangeMenu
classes.description: Represents a date range selection menu with methods to select options and close the menu.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the menu or component is visible.

methods.name: getMenuItem
methods.description: Retrieves a menu item by text.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Applies filter settings and waits for the popover to close.

methods.name: searchInTeamMenu
methods.description: Searches for a team in the team filter input.

methods.name: filterByTeam
methods.description: Filters by team, either opening dropdown directly or searching first.

methods.name: filterByRole
methods.description: Filters by role, opening the menu and selecting an option.

methods.name: filterByStatus
methods.description: Filters by status, opening the menu and selecting an option.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Simulates clicking on a menu item.
